description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `BaseStorageService` that implements temporary storage functionalities for the OpenMRS system. It manages saving and retrieving temporary data streams, generating unique keys for stored data, and encoding/decoding keys for safe URL transmission. The class extends a base service and implements storage service interface, utilizing streaming data services and file system operations.

classes.name: BaseStorageService
classes.description: An abstract class implementing storage functionalities including saving and retrieving temporary data, key management, and encoding/decoding keys, for the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getTempData
methods.description: Retrieves temporary data as an InputStream given a key, throwing an IOException if the file does not exist.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Saves data from an InputStream or StreamDataWriter, associates metadata and module/group identifiers, and returns a generated key.

methods.name: saveTempData
methods.description: Stores data temporarily as a temp file and returns its filename as a key.

methods.name: newKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for stored data, incorporating module/grp, timestamp, random string, and optional filename.

methods.name: decodeKey
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded key string into a normal string.

methods.name: encodeKey
methods.description: URL-encodes a key string, replacing certain characters for safe transmission.
